final_message:
Yen receipts now show correctly: `Paid ¥500 by card`. `npm test` passes, 18 of 18.

The cause is the shared `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`, which divides every amount by 100. That's wrong for yen, which has no minor unit. A project fence says this task only touches `src/payments`, so I left that file alone. I fixed it in `src/payments/receipt.js` instead, where JPY amounts are now printed as whole units.

Other callers of `formatMoney` (invoices, cart, admin) will still show yen amounts divided by 100. Fixing that in `formatMoney` itself would need a change outside `src/payments`. Say if you want it.

One of my first attempts at the edit was blocked by the fence hook, which misread the word "Paid" in my command as a path. I made the same edit with the Edit tool, on a file inside the allowed area.
